summary: Frontend UI validation for 4 governance features (SoD scorecard alerts, evidence exports, trend annotations, mover-rule report export). All 22 required data-testids are present and interactive. Score-alert-check toast, evidence send-now toast, PDF/CSV downloads (SoD evidence + mover autostrip log), filtered CSV export by 'Vikram' (1 record), scorecard-annotations block and scorecard-trend-tip custom tooltip all VERIFIED working. Prior chat webhook controls (digest-chat-toggle, digest-teams-url, digest-slack-url) NOT regressed. ONE CRITICAL BUG: PUT /api/sap/digest/config returns 500 because Pydantic DigestConfigBody model is missing the 5 new fields (score_alert, score_threshold, evidence_export, evidence_recipients, evidence_day) — save silently fails and the frontend shows the misleading toast 'Could not save (admin only)'. After reload, threshold reverted to 60 default and recipients were empty, confirming persistence is broken.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error. sap_digest.py line 160 accesses body.evidence_recipients but DigestConfigBody (line 127) only declares enabled/recipients/days/chat_alert/teams_url/slack_url. Missing: score_alert:bool, score_threshold:int, evidence_export:bool, evidence_recipients:list[str], evidence_day:str. Backend traceback: AttributeError: 'DigestConfigBody' object has no attribute 'evidence_recipients'. Consequently digest-save NEVER persists the new fields and reload restores defaults.

ui_bugs.issue: 500 from PUT digest/config is surfaced to the user as 'Could not save (admin only)' — misleading, because the user IS admin. Handler should show a generic error toast or bubble the real error.

integration_issues.flow: Save digest schedule -> reload -> config persists
integration_issues.issue: Broken end-to-end because backend 500s (see backend critical). After reload, score-threshold reverted from 72 to 60, evidence-recipients empty, evidence-export-toggle stayed false despite being toggled on. score-alert-toggle happened to stay true only because it was already true from prior state.

action_items: Add the 5 missing fields to DigestConfigBody in /app/backend/sap_digest.py: score_alert:bool=True, score_threshold:int=60, evidence_export:bool=False, evidence_recipients:list[str]=[], evidence_day:str='mon'. This will fix the 500 and unblock the persistence flow (Feature #4).
Improve error handling in the digest-save frontend handler so a 500 does not show the 'admin only' toast (which is normally reserved for 403).
critical_code_review_comments: DigestConfigBody Pydantic model is out of sync with the endpoint body access — introducing new PUT fields without extending the model is a common regression class. Consider a single source of truth (_DIGEST_DEFAULT) with a Pydantic model generated from it, or add a unit test that PUTs every documented field.
The generic 'Could not save (admin only)' toast masks real errors — check response.status before assuming 403.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — UI elements 100% present; only save-persistence flow fails due to backend model bug

seed_data_creation: None. Mover auto-strip log was already populated when Lifecycle was opened (mover-log-search/days/export-csv/export-pdf all present without toggling).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 22 data-testids for the 4 new features are wired correctly. Downloads (sap-sod-evidence.pdf/csv, sap-mover-autostrip-log.csv/pdf) all trigger successfully. Filtered CSV export via mover-log-search='Vikram' correctly produced 1 record (CHG100569, Vikram Okafor). The ONLY blocker is the Pydantic DigestConfigBody missing 5 fields causing PUT /api/sap/digest/config to 500. After main agent fixes the model, retest persistence: set threshold=72, toggle both on, set day=Wednesday, recipients='auditor@example.com', save, reload, verify all persist.
rca of the issue: New PUT /api/sap/digest/config handler code (sap_digest.py lines 160-165) accesses body.score_alert / body.score_threshold / body.evidence_export / body.evidence_recipients / body.evidence_day, but the DigestConfigBody Pydantic model (lines 127-133) was not extended to declare those attributes. Pydantic v2 raises AttributeError on undeclared attribute access, FastAPI converts that to a 500. Reproduction: log in as admin, open /app/sod, change any of the new fields, click digest-save; observe the frontend toast 'Could not save (admin only)' and the backend log 'AttributeError: DigestConfigBody object has no attribute evidence_recipients'. Fix: extend DigestConfigBody with score_alert:bool=True, score_threshold:int=60, evidence_export:bool=False, evidence_recipients:list[str]=[], evidence_day:str='mon' (defaults matching _DIGEST_DEFAULT at lines 81-82).
